Title: Complications and outcome of atypical preeclampsia, and eclampsia, at al Saudi Hospital, Sudan
Abstract: @DISEASE_Pre_Eclampsia @DISEASE_MESH:D011225 @@@<m>Preeclampsia</m>@@@, as defined by the American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists (<m>ACOG</m>) in their current <m>practice</m> <m>bulletin</m>, is the occurrence of systolic blood pressure equal to or greater than 140 mmHg and diastolic blood pressure equal to or greater than 90 mmHg on two separate occasions at least 4 h apart after 20 weeks of <m>pregnancy</m> in a @SPECIES_9606 @@@woman@@@ who previously had <m>normal</m> blood pressure.
